items.title: What kind of project is a good fit?
items.answer: A focused brand system, landing or company website, or a website connected to an agreed business workflow. Larger applications and commerce systems need separate evaluation.

items.title: Can you work in Russian and English?
items.answer: Yes. We can design one system for both languages. Translation into additional languages is scoped separately with an approved specialist when needed.

items.title: Which integrations can you connect?
items.answer: Forms, CRM adapters, email, calendars, analytics and limited automations can be considered after we check API access, regional availability, permissions and data requirements.

items.title: What happens after launch?
items.answer: The agreed handover includes sources, access mapping, QA evidence and operating notes. A bounded evolution package can be scoped separately.
